system.description: The conjurer concentrates especially hard when weaving the vitner. By using extra vitner during a spell, the chances to succeed increase. For each level of this specialty , the conjurer may use 2 Vitner Points to get a +1 modifier on the Skill roll. A conjurer with level 3 of the specialty can therefore use an extra 6 Vitner Points to get +3 on their Skill Value, and a conjurer with level 5 can use an extra 10 Vitner Points to get +5. How many Vitner Points the conjurer wants to add is up to them, provided that they do not exceed what their specialty level permits.
system.summary: Invests extra Vitner Points while casting to increase the odds of success.
